title: 洛迦胜境 Luojia Shengjing
subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: On the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class, its form drawn by the hall kit. It will be updated as the research goes on.
rows: platform 0.45 m, eave 3.2 m, ridge 5.8 m above the ground
gable 硬山 or 悬山, rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile

by the hall kit: 3 bays, the middle widest, a porch front, steps on the front, 硬山 flush gable with a rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile, a painted beam under the eave. Drawn from the typology of its hall class, not from a picture of this hall (assumed, C).

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 曲院风荷
evidence.excerpt_zh: 坐石臨流東南當碧桐書院正東為麴院風荷五楹南嚮其西佛樓為洛迦勝境（圓明園册）臣等謹按麴院風荷四十景之一額為皇上御書洛迦勝境額亦御書
evidence.summary: East of 碧桐書院: 麴院風荷, five bays facing south, with the Buddha tower 洛迦勝境 to its west.

evidence.title: 曲院风荷: 嘉庆元年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆元年 (1796), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.257 item (2), under 曲院风荷
evidence.excerpt_zh: 显迹传东土，如来平等观。西方常住锡，南海永安澜。法律三车演，庄严七宝攒。长称圣人寿，普被福田宽。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 曲院风荷, 1796, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 曲院风荷: 嘉庆七年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆七年 (1802), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.257 item (4), under 曲院风荷
evidence.excerpt_zh: 海南卓锡畅宗风，应感随声示现同。人我尽包四生转，慈悲原在一心通。六时钟磬真仍幻，三月莺花色即空。若向个中寻住脚，痴人说梦总愚蒙。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 曲院风荷, 1802, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
